title.description: Overrides info.title in the <title> element and site header. Defaults to info.title.

theme.description: Initial colour theme. 'auto' (default) follows the user's prefers-color-scheme; the toggle in the header switches and persists.

includeSchemas.description: Whether to emit per-schema pages under schemas/. Defaults to true.

baseUrl.description: Site origin used to render absolute <link rel="canonical"> hrefs. Optional; internal navigation always uses relative URLs.

enableTryIt.description: When true (default), each operation page renders an in-browser request builder. Disable for read-only static docs or when CORS makes the runtime call useless.
